verdict.rationale: GitHub supports background autonomous automation via CI/CD (Actions) and via assigning tasks to the Copilot coding agent, which independently analyzes and edits code without live supervision (github-docs-4, github-docs-9, github-docs-11, github-docs-13). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduling/triggers for autonomous runs, independent/hands-on validation that Copilot-assigned tasks complete unattended, and deeper technical detail beyond marketing copy.
